newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-ND rests Pocock, Vettori vs Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ND rests Pocock, Vettori vs Sri Lanka.

text.p: HAMILTON, Feb 26 - Northern Districts have opted to rest test players Blair Pocock and Daniel Vettori from their cricket team which will play Sri Lanka in a two-day warm up tour match in Taupo on Thursday and Friday.
Pocock and Vettori will still get a good sight of the tourists in the New Zealand A team which plays Sri Lanka in a three-day match starting in Gisborne on Sunday.
The Taupo match does not have first-class status.
Opening bowler Scott Styris has a side strain while Dion Nash has also been left out of the ND team which is currently playing Wellington in Hamilton.

Bay of Plenty youngsters Mark Tesar and Gavin Donne, who played in the ND development team last week, have been called in for their first senior appearances, while Alex O'Dowd and Dion Bennett have been recalled.
Tesar is a right-arm medium pacer and Donne a very capable all-rounder.
Northern Districts: Robbie Hart (capt), Matthew Bell, Grant Bradburn, Matthew Hart, Mark Bailey, Michael Parlane, Alex Tait, Alex O'Dowd, Mark Tesar, Gavin Donne, Dion Bennett, Joseph Yovich.
